```{r}
# Functions

getResultsByItem <- function(dfRaw, listaNorm, dm, item){
  # just a common object
  # dm <- as.data.frame(lista[[1]][["metadata"]])
  # cat(item, "\n")
  colnames(dm) <- c("Samples", "Groups")
  grupos <- unique(dm$Groups)
  numRows <- ceiling(length(listaNorm)/2)
  empties <- replicate(numRows-3, ggplot() + theme_void(), simplify = FALSE)
  
  # Starting with data extraction and metrics/graphs estimation... 
  if (item == "item0"){ # only item 0
    empties <- c(Biomics::plotBarTI(data = dfRaw, interact = F)$grafico, empties)
    output <-  ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = empties, ncol = 1, nrow = numRows-2)
  } else { # other items
    # First extrating individual data and generating individual plots
    a <<- 0
    finalData <- lapply(listaNorm, function(datos){
      a <<- a+1
      # cat(a, "\n")
      nome <- names(listaNorm)[a]
      if (item == "item6"){
        Biomics::plotBoxMulti(
          base = datos, varResumen = colnames(datos),
          interact = F, tituloX = nome
        )$grafico
      } else if (item == "item5"){
        Biomics::plotRLE(df = datos, normalizacion = nome, interact = F, 
                         tituloX = nome)$grafico
      } else if (item == "item4"){
        Biomics::plotMeanSD(df = datos, interact = F, tituloX = nome)$grafico
      } else if (item == "item3"){
        Biomics::plotMA(df = datos, dfGrupos = dm, gControl = grupos[1], titulo = nome,
                        gCase = grupos[2], showR2 = F, interact = F)$grafico
      }
    })
    names(finalData) <- paste0("SimDataset_",1:length(finalData))
    # Mix plots into a single image or...
    if (item %in% c("item3", "item4", "item5", "item6")){ # plot graphs together: MAplot, RLEplot, meanSDplot, TIboxplot
      output <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = finalData, 
                                  ncol = 2, nrow = numRows)
    } else if (item == "item1"){ # ...or generate other metrics with data for remaining items
      empties <- c(Biomics::getPCV( # PVC
        listData = listaNorm,
        grupos = grupos,
        dfGrupos = dm,
        grafico = T,
        interact = F
      )$grafico, empties)
       output <-  ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = empties, ncol = 1, nrow = numRows-2)
    } else if (item =="item2"){ # Correlation
      allVectorsCorr <- lapply(
        listaNorm, 
        Biomics::getPooledCor, 
        dfGrupos = dm,
        metodo = "spearman")
      dfPlot <- data.frame(sapply(allVectorsCorr, "length<-", max(lengths(allVectorsCorr))))
      empties <- c(Biomics::plotBoxMulti(
        base = dfPlot, 
        varResumen = colnames(dfPlot),
        tituloX = "Normalizations", interact = F,
        tituloY = "Spearman correlation")$grafico, empties)
      output <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = empties, ncol = 1, nrow = numRows-2)
    }
    
  } 
  res <- list(output)
  names(res) <- item
  return(res)
}
```

# Assessment

```{r include = F}
# allFiles <- list.files(path = "ProcessedDatasets/")
allFilesDDA <- df %>% filter(Acquisition == "DDA") %>% pull(ID) %>% paste0(., ".rds")
listGraphs <- sapply(allFilesDDA, function(i){
  # cat("\n", i)
  output <- readRDS(file = paste0(outDir, i))
  # getResults(dfRaw = output$data, datos = output$dataLog, dm = output$dm)
  resultado <- sapply(items, 
    getResultsByItem,
    dfRaw = output$data, 
    listaNorm = output$listaNorm, 
    dm =  output$dm, 
    simplify = F, 
    USE.NAMES = T
    )
  return(resultado)
},simplify = F, USE.NAMES = T)
```

## DDA datasets {.tabset}

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=18, fig.width=10}
invisible(sapply(allFilesDDA, function(i){
  idDataset <- substr(i, start = 1, stop = nchar(i)-4)
  cat("\n\n### ", idDataset, " {- .tabset .tabset-dropdown}\n\n")
  
  sapply(items, function(item){
    cat("\n\n#### ", item, " {-}\n\n")
    print(listGraphs[[i]][[item]])
  })
  
  # print(listGraphs[[i]])
  cat("\n\n")
}))

```
